title: [clinic · EX-14] Beat the reranker
body:
> **Exercise clinic.** One long-running thread per exercise. Ask here rather than opening a
> new thread — the answers accumulate where the next person will look for them.
>
> **Exercise:** [`EX-14` — Beat the reranker](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/30-learning/exercises/ex-14-beat-the-reranker.md) · difficulty 🔴

## What this exercise asks

Read the exercise first; this thread is for when you are stuck, not instead of it.

## Three ways people get stuck on this one

**1.** Adding features the first stage already used. A reranker over the same signals is an expensive identity function — the finding in [#4](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/issues/4).

**2.** Tuning weights before checking the feature set. The grid search in #4 lost, and that is what promoted the diagnosis from weights to features.

**3.** Reranking a depth so shallow that there is nothing left to reorder.

## How to ask here

Post the **numbers you got**, the **config that produced them**, and **what you already tried**.
A question with a measurement in it gets answered in one round trip; a question without one
takes three.

If you have finished it, post the write-up in **Show and Tell** with the
`[solution · EX-14]` prefix rather than here — this thread stays for people who are stuck.
